title: 港交所CEO陈翊庭：延长交易时段，提升市场可及性
speaker: Bonnie Chan

segments.en: So, I get asked that question a lot as well, extension of trading hours.
segments.zh: 我也经常被问到这个问题，延长交易时间。

segments.en: So first of all, I would generalize it to say that investors want better access.
segments.zh: 首先，我想概括地说，投资者想要更好的可及性。

segments.en: Accessibility is what investors want, and with technology, right?
segments.zh: 可及性是投资者想要的，而且借助技术，对吧？

segments.en: You know, you want to take your mobile phone out and be able to trade whenever you want to.
segments.zh: 你知道，你想拿出手机，随时都能交易。

segments.en: So as a general theme, we certainly will be working on a lot of initiatives to improve accessibility.
segments.zh: 因此，作为总体主题，我们肯定会致力于许多举措来提高可及性。

segments.en: That is something we'll do for sure.
Now, with trading hours, each market is slightly different.
segments.zh: 关于交易时间，每个市场略有不同。

segments.en: What we think we will do, and you have shared with the market before, we will start with the derivative market, which in fact, we now trade until 3 a.m. in the morning already.
segments.zh: 我们计划做的是，先从衍生品市场开始，实际上我们现在已经交易到凌晨3点。

segments.en: But that, we see good potential to extend it so that we can overlap with the opening of the US hour.
segments.zh: 但我们看到有很好的潜力延长交易时间，以便与美国市场开盘时间重叠。

segments.en: And therefore, I think in the first phase, you should expect to hear from us the extension of trading hours on the derivatives side.
segments.zh: 因此，在第一阶段，你应该会听到我们延长衍生品交易时间的消息。

segments.en: Yeah, and that was Bonnie Chan, of course, the CEO of HKX with our very own, of course, Minmin Lowe there.
segments.zh: 是的，那是港交所CEO陈翊庭，与我们的主持人Minmin Lowe。
